title: IT Business Analyst
text: IT Business Analyst at Australian Clinical Labs (Melbourne, Bayside & South Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Australian Clinical Labs was created through the merger of Healthscope, St John of God and Perth Pathology. Through the long term relationships with these organisations and our public hospital contacts, Clinical Labs is now the leading provider of Hospital/Specialist pathology services in Australia. We see our future in the industry as taking a leadership role in science, technology, people and process. With 88 accredited pathology laboratories and over 1020 collection centres, we have a strong footprint across Australia. We have an ambitious goal to deliver continuous business/ process improvements to our organisation and transfer these benefits to all our customers. We have recently initiated a national time and attendance (T&A) project that will transform the way we operate and bring about greater collaboration, efficiencies and transparency. In order to ensure success to this project we are seeking like-minded people who are ready for the challenge. We are looking for an IT Business Analyst (IT BA) who will work alongside a Business Improvement Manager during implementation. Post implementation, the IT BA will undertake the role of System Administrator and drive further improvements and synergies within the organisation. You will need to be comfortable working within a payroll environment and be a self-starter. Your role will require not only IT competencies but also administration and content up-keeping. Other deliverables will include analysis through the creation of reports and dashboards and effectively communicating actionable insights. Knowledge/Skills Required Strong knowledge and experience across a variety of software and web development facets, from JavaScript, HTML, CSS, MySQL, iQuery, API Scripting. Demonstrated experience in migration/ integration/ projects (including design, UAT). Able to create functional and technical requirements documentation. Good experience in analytical tools such as Excel is preferred. Business/ Process improvement experience is preferred. Payroll related knowledge and experience (Award/ EBA) is an advantage. Attributes Innovative at heart and passion for quality. Determined and meticulous in driving and completing projects/ assignments. Enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. For the opportunity to work in a business in a time of significant growth, click the Apply button now!
